messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Measure fit indices
parts: The chi-square is a measure of badness of fit. The baseline model, which forces orthogonality across all observed variables, should always fit much worse (have a much higher chi-square relative to degrees of freedom)  than the target model. These issues should be covered in any basic text on structural equation modeling.
